clues: This capital city sits in the far south of Chile. It rests near the tip of South America.
Due to its far south spot, it stays very cold. It is the coldest big coast city in Latin America.
In 1927 the city took a new official name. In 1938 leaders changed it back.
Ships sail from this port toward Antarctica. It is a main starting point for trips there.
This place claims the title of farthest south city on Earth. Two smaller towns say the title is theirs.
